field.name: Volve
sources: github.com/BinWang0213/Course-PETE4241_19SP_ProjectCode (F-4, F-5, F-12, F-14, F-15 D input LAS)
github.com/dabiged/Volve2OPM (Volve Eclipse deck for OPM Flow; re-run in this project) and f0nzie/reservoir_datasets (original 2016 deck)

wells.name: 15/9-F-11 B
wells.surveyNote: Definitive directional survey (299 stations). Agrees with the official formation-pick coordinates within 0.6 m.
wells.summary: Horizontal Hugin Fm producer. Shares the upper hole with 15/9-F-11 A and was sidetracked from it at ~2585 m MD, then landed near-horizontal and weaves through the thin Hugin reservoir seven times.

wells.name: 15/9-F-11 A
wells.surveyNote: Definitive directional survey (319 stations). Agrees with the official formation-pick coordinates within 0.6 m.
wells.summary: Deviated (≈40°) pilot wellbore with a full reservoir log suite including compressional and shear sonic, plus Equinor's computed petrophysical interpretation (CPI).

wells.name: 15/9-F-1 C
wells.surveyNote: Definitive directional survey (112 stations). Agrees with the official formation-pick coordinates within 0.6 m.
wells.summary: High-angle producer (later converted to water injector) with Equinor CPI and daily production 2014–2016.

wells.name: 15/9-F-12
wells.surveyNote: Definitive directional survey (211 stations). Agrees with the official formation-pick coordinates within 0.6 m.
wells.summary: Volve's most prolific producer (≈4.6 million Sm³ oil), with logs and Equinor CPI across the reservoir.

wells.name: 15/9-F-1 A
wells.summary: Deviated wellbore with a full reservoir log suite including compressional and shear sonic, and Equinor CPI.

wells.name: 15/9-F-1 B
wells.summary: Sidetrack of F-1 with sonic (DT, DTS) across the reservoir and Equinor CPI.

wells.name: 15/9-F-14
wells.summary: Producer with sonic across most of the hole (logs in feet in the source file). ≈3.9 million Sm³ oil.

wells.name: 15/9-F-15 D
wells.summary: Late-life producer (2014–2016) with a long reservoir section and Equinor CPI.

wells.name: 15/9-F-4
wells.summary: Water injector supporting reservoir pressure (logs in feet in the source file).

wells.name: 15/9-F-5
wells.summary: Water injector (logs in feet in the source file).
